Tool calls are checked before execution against wall time, total-call, identical-action retry and consecutive-no-progress limits. Exhausted tasks stop unless the action is task status or final reporting.
ctf_evidence_record and ctf_register_artifact place agent-reported commands, stdout/stderr and task-local artifacts in the evidence ledger with SHA-256 hashes.

HTTP/file inspection exposes automatic flag candidates; ctf_flag_scan registers artifact candidates; ctf_flag_submit requires an in-scope endpoint and response regex before assigning platform_verified.

ctf_remote_exec uses OpenSSH with exact host/port scope enforcement, strict host keys, bounded timeout/output and evidence logging. Destructive command patterns require explicit destructive_confirmed=true. ctf_remote_http exposes only a fixed curl request builder and requires both the SSH gateway and HTTP target to be in scope. Unit-tested locally; a live end-to-end SSH check requires an authorized host and credentials.

Playwright tools/call is checked against the active task budget before forwarding. The smoke test recorded six browser calls, six browser_tool_call evidence events and nine hashed browser artifacts; blocked budget calls are returned as MCP tool errors.
